# oe_eln.3 — Altars of the New World: Three Paths of Faith
oe_eln.3 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_eln.3.title
	desc = oe_eln.3.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_eln_senatus_hesperiae.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_ai = no
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_faith_path }
	}

	# Path A: Western Ecumenical Orthodoxy
	option = {
		name = oe_eln.3.a
		ai_chance = { base = 55 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln.3.a.tt
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_faith_path value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_faith_path_ticks value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = religion
				NOT = { religion ?= religion:orthodox }
			}
			change_religion = religion:orthodox
		}
		else = {
			add_stability = stability_mild_bonus
			add_religious_influence_if_valid = { VALUE = 15 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_eln_mod_orthodox_foundation
			years = 20
			mode = replace
		}
		add_estate_satisfaction = {
			type = estate_type:clergy_estate
			value = estate_satisfaction_mild_bonus
		}
	}

	# Path B: Nova Elysia Religio Romana (deep v9.8 Hexapantheon synergy, strictly <= 6 gods!)
	option = {
		name = oe_eln.3.b
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln.3.b.tt
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_faith_path value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_faith_path_ticks value = 0 }
		add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
		add_estate_satisfaction = {
			type = estate_type:clergy_estate
			value = estate_satisfaction_severe_penalty
		}
		oe_eln_convert_to_religio_romana = yes
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_eln_mod_hesperian_revival
			years = 20
			mode = replace
		}
	}

	# Path C: Atlantic Edict of Symmachus (Transatlantic Religious Toleration)
	option = {
		name = oe_eln.3.c
		ai_chance = { base = 15 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln.3.c.tt
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_faith_path value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_faith_path_ticks value = 0 }
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_eln_mod_symmachus_charter
			years = 25
			mode = replace
		}
		culture = { add_cultural_tradition = 6 }
		add_estate_satisfaction = {
			type = estate_type:clergy_estate
			value = estate_satisfaction_mild_penalty
		}
	}
}

# oe_eln.10 — Military Line: Chalybopolis Arsenal — Greek Fire Meets the Arquebus
oe_eln.10 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_eln.10.title
	desc = oe_eln.10.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_eln_pyrophoroi.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_pyrophoroi_ready value = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_eln.10.a
		ai_chance = { base = 60 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln.10.a.tt
		add_gold = -80
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_eln_mod_pyrophoroi_doctrine
			years = -1
			mode = replace
		}
		add_army_tradition = army_tradition_mild_bonus
		if = {
			limit = {
				location:kiskiack = {
					has_owner = yes
					owner ?= root
				}
			}
			location:kiskiack = {
				add_location_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_eln_chalybopolis_foundry_loc_mod
					years = 25
					mode = replace
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			capital = {
				add_location_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_eln_chalybopolis_foundry_loc_mod
					years = 25
					mode = replace
				}
			}
		}
	}

	option = {

		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln.10.b.tt
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_eln_mod_pyrophoroi_elite_guard
			years = -1
			mode = replace

# WESTERN PANTHEON HEXAPANTHEON SEAT-SWAPPER (oe_eln_pantheon.1)
# ==============================================================================
oe_eln_pantheon.1 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_eln_pantheon.1.title
	desc = oe_eln_pantheon.1.desc
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_wnd_theodosian.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		exists = religion
		religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_eln_pantheon.1.a
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		trigger = {
			has_variable = oe_eln_unlocked_sol_hesperius
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_seated_sol_hesperius }
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln_pantheon.1.a.tt
		oe_eln_seat_sol_hesperius = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_eln_pantheon.1.b
		ai_chance = { base = 10 }
		trigger = {
			has_variable = oe_eln_seated_sol_hesperius
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln_pantheon.1.b.tt
		oe_eln_unseat_sol_hesperius = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_eln_pantheon.1.c
		ai_chance = { base = 10 }
		trigger = {
			has_variable = oe_eln_unlocked_oceanus_neptune
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_seated_oceanus_neptune }
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln_pantheon.1.c.tt
		oe_eln_seat_oceanus_neptune = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_eln_pantheon.1.d
		ai_chance = { base = 10 }
		trigger = {
			has_variable = oe_eln_seated_oceanus_neptune
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln_pantheon.1.d.tt
		oe_eln_unseat_oceanus_neptune = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_eln_pantheon.1.e
		ai_chance = { base = 10 }
		trigger = {
			has_variable = oe_eln_unlocked_sol_hesperius
			has_variable = oe_eln_unlocked_oceanus_neptune
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_seated_sol_hesperius }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_seated_oceanus_neptune }
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln_pantheon.1.e.tt
		oe_eln_seat_sol_hesperius = yes
		oe_eln_seat_oceanus_neptune = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_eln_pantheon.1.f
		ai_chance = { base = 10 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln_pantheon.1.f.tt
		oe_eln_reset_western_gods = yes
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp_ritual.10
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_eln_pantheon.1.z
		ai_chance = { base = 10 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln_pantheon.1.z.tt
	}
}
